summary: Raytech Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing the abrupt resignation of director Shihua Li and CFO Yee Hing Wan, effective August 15, 2026. The board appointed Dr. Gen Zhao as independent director and audit committee chair, and Songbin Yang as CFO. Resignations were not due to disagreements. No deal terms were disclosed. The board determined Zhao's independence despite his role at an affiliate of a major shareholder. Watch for any operational or governance implications from the sudden leadership shift.
